create_apply_default_group_assignment: create a default group assignment that adds a user to a specified group on registration
build_add_users_to_group: build a method to add one or more users to an existing group by group ID
remove_users_from_group: remove specified users from a group by group ID and user ID list
create_group: create a new group with a name, description, and optional permissions and data fields
list_groups: list all groups with member counts and return paginated results
